b2-festeszet-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Munkácsy in Debrecen
b2-festeszet-01.scenario: In the Déri Múzeum in Debrecen, a visitor asks you about Munkácsy's start and his first great success.
b2-festeszet-01.prompt: Tell him what Munkácsy was in Békéscsaba and what he showed in Paris in 1870.
cues: Say what Munkácsy did for a living in Békéscsaba
Say what he showed in Paris in 1870 and how it went
b2-festeszet-01.target: Munkácsy Békéscsabán asztalosként dolgozva fordult a festészet felé. 1870-ben a párizsi Szalonban bemutatta a Siralomház című képét, és nagy sikere volt.
b2-festeszet-01.english: Working as a carpenter in Békéscsaba, Munkácsy turned to painting. In 1870 he showed his picture The Condemned Cell at the Paris Salon and it was a great success.
b2-festeszet-01.canDo: I can trace Mihály Munkácsy's rise from a carpenter's apprentice to a celebrated painter in Paris.

b2-festeszet-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Majális and Nagybánya
b2-festeszet-02.scenario: At an art-history talk in Budapest, a student asks what happened to Szinyei Merse after the Majális and what the painters of Nagybánya did differently.
b2-festeszet-02.prompt: Tell her how Szinyei Merse reacted to the criticism and where the Nagybánya painters worked.
cues: Say how Szinyei Merse reacted to the criticism
Say where the Nagybánya painters worked
b2-festeszet-02.target: Szinyei Merse a bírálatoktól elkeseredve visszavonult a birtokára. A nagybányai festők a sötét műtermekből kilépve a szabad ég alatt festettek.
b2-festeszet-02.english: Embittered by the criticism, Szinyei Merse withdrew to his estate. The Nagybánya painters, stepping out of the dark studios, painted in the open air.
b2-festeszet-02.canDo: I can explain the significance of Szinyei Merse Pál's Majális (1873) and the 1896 Nagybánya artists' colony.

b2-festeszet-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Pharmacist Painter
b2-festeszet-03.scenario: In the Csontváry Museum in Pécs, a guide asks what you know about the painter's early life.
b2-festeszet-03.prompt: Tell her what Csontváry did for years after the strange prophecy and what kind of artist he was.
cues: Say what he did for years after the prophecy
Say what kind of artist he was, giving the reason
b2-festeszet-03.target: Csontváry hallván a különös próféciát, éveken át gyógyszerészként dolgozott és takarékoskodott. Magányos zseni lévén a saját útját járta a művészetben.
b2-festeszet-03.english: Upon hearing the strange prophecy, Csontváry worked as a pharmacist and saved money for years. Being a solitary genius, he walked his own path in art.
b2-festeszet-03.canDo: I can recount the life and visionary art of Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka (from apothecary to painter of the 'Sun Path').

b2-festeszet-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Light-Space Modulator
b2-festeszet-04.scenario: In a lecture about the Bauhaus, a student asks how Moholy-Nagy's Light-Space Modulator was made and how it works.
b2-festeszet-04.prompt: Tell her what it was made of and what happens when it is lit.
cues: Say what the modulator was made of
Say what happens when it is lit with spotlights
b2-festeszet-04.target: A Fény-tér-modulátor krómozott acélból és üvegből volt összeállítva. Amikor reflektorokkal meg van világítva, a falakon fény-árnyék színház születik.
b2-festeszet-04.english: The Light-Space Modulator was assembled from chromed steel and glass. When it is lit with spotlights, a theatre of light and shadow is born on the walls.
b2-festeszet-04.canDo: I can explain the contribution of Kassák Lajos's MA circle and László Moholy-Nagy at the Bauhaus.

b2-festeszet-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Heroes' Square
b2-festeszet-05.scenario: On Hősök tere in Budapest, a tourist asks which museums stand opposite each other and where the history of Hungarian painting is shown.
b2-festeszet-05.prompt: Tell him which two buildings face each other and where the old Hungarian painting is housed.
cues: Say which two buildings face each other
Say where the historical collection of Hungarian painting is housed
b2-festeszet-05.target: A Hősök terén a Szépművészeti Múzeum és a Műcsarnok áll egymással szemben. A magyar festészet történeti gyűjteménye a Budai Várban van elhelyezve.
b2-festeszet-05.english: On Heroes' Square the Museum of Fine Arts and the Műcsarnok face each other. The historical collection of Hungarian painting is housed in Buda Castle.
b2-festeszet-05.canDo: I can discuss Budapest's major art institutions (Szépművészeti Múzeum, Magyar Nemzeti Galéria, Műcsarnok).

b2-festeszet-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: From Munkácsy to Moholy-Nagy
b2-festeszet-consolidation.scenario: At a gallery in Budapest, a foreign visitor asks for a short overview of Hungarian painting from Munkácsy to Moholy-Nagy.
b2-festeszet-consolidation.prompt: Give a short overview: Munkácsy in Paris, Csontváry, and Moholy-Nagy's light sculpture.
cues: Say what Munkácsy painted in Paris
Say what kind of artist Csontváry was, giving the reason
Say what Moholy-Nagy built and how it is lit
b2-festeszet-consolidation.target: Munkácsy Párizsban sötét, drámai képeket festett. Csontváry magányos zseni lévén a saját útját járta. Moholy-Nagy kinetikus fényszobrot épített, amely reflektorokkal meg van világítva.
b2-festeszet-consolidation.english: In Paris Munkácsy painted dark, dramatic pictures. Being a solitary genius, Csontváry walked his own path. Moholy-Nagy built a kinetic light sculpture, which is lit with spotlights.
b2-festeszet-consolidation.canDo: I can trace Hungarian visual art from Munkácsy's salon realism and Szinyei Merse's Majális through the Nagybánya colony and Csontváry's cosmic visions to Moholy-Nagy at the Bauhaus.
